mission: Close the remaining gap between independently verifying archived bytes and restoring usable media without the original local source, with meaningful direct-main GitHub commits.

basis.finding: The existing signed, independently authorized GET path checked every original part and the whole-object SHA-256, then discarded the returned bytes. Source removal therefore left an integrity report but no recovered media.

delivered.scope: RetrievalObservation::verify_with_bytes returns a private VerifiedRetrievalBytes only after all range/part/whole-object checks, final live authority and immutable source checks, and successful reader settlement. Existing streaming verify remains unchanged in cost and memory behavior.
delivered.provenance: The opaque value retains its exact settled RetrievalReceipt, exposes borrowed immutable bytes and receipt only, redacts Debug, does not implement Clone, and clears retained bytes on drop. No byte value escapes a failed attempt.
delivered.cost: An additional full-object byte allowance is spent before buffer allocation or the first provider request. Existing signed request, network, range, hashing and local-output costs remain separately charged.

delivered.scope: upload-s3-restore composes the verified-byte owner with explicit separate local output authority, a private exclusive destination and the independently retained verification receipt.
delivered.compatibility: Supports both original Completed/Verified uploads and the already supported positive independently pinned completion observation for a locally indeterminate upload. Original upload history and consumed authority remain unchanged.
delivered.output: Exclusive new private single-link regular file under a pinned parent directory descriptor. Write/readback capacity is admitted before creation. Exact stable readback and file/parent fsync distinguish output_created, output_verified and output_durable. Partial output is neither removed nor reused after failure.
delivered.receipt: The existing bounded canonical v1/v2 retrieval receipt remains separate from the restored media. The CLI requires both durable media and durable receipt for a successful result; the returned report keeps these states distinct.

authority.repository: User authorized direct commits to main through GitHub, with no PR. Parent/ref comparison preserves concurrent main changes.
authority.retrieval: Fresh exact AdapterNet, AdapterAuth and ReadMedia grants bind the original resource, identity, privacy and custody origin. Retrieval grants no provider stage, publication, abort or deletion authority.
authority.output: Separate exact ObjectStage local destination authority expires at the requested restore deadline, even if receipt cleanup remains allowed later. Received verified bytes give no filesystem or disclosure authority.
authority.network: Only deterministic fixtures and explicit loopback tests are in scope. No owner device, production archive, NAS or cloud-provider account was contacted.

coverage: Exact original bytes across multiple original parts and range boundaries.
One additional full-object byte charge without changing streaming verifier cost.
Budget refusal before allocation/provider reads; partial-budget failure and final post-hash deadline refusal.
Cancellation before read admission and later settlement.
Short, corrupted, provider-failed or representation-changed ranges return no partial media.
Observed indeterminate completion preserves original journal, phase, historical spend and evidence links.
Cold-process source removal, restored private mode, receipt linkage and unchanged upload journal.
Occupied paths, symlinks, aliases and expired output requests refuse before provider access.
